 All GTA 6 bugs and glitches we've found so far 
 All GTA 6 bugs and glitches we've found so far
 By 
 Akash Paul 
 Modified Nov 18, 2026 20:56 IST 
 Exploring all GTA 6 bugs and glitches (Image via Rockstar Games) 
 GTA 6 has officially launched , and beneath its massive open-world offering, the game is not without its fair share of bugs and glitches . They can hinder your gameplay experience and often require a restart and workaround to fix, until officials roll out a hotfix. With streamers and players reporting issues online, tracking them all has become much easier.
 Ad 
 This article explores all the GTA 6 bugs and glitches we've found so far.
 All GTA 6 bugs and glitches explored
 Here are some of the bugs and glitches reported on GTA 6's launch day :
 Clipping through walls
 In a massive open-world game, players often come across a wall or an object that characters can clip through. Whether it's the missing polygons or simply textures not loading, it throws off the immersion. While playing Rockstar's newest title, streamer MichaelDoesLife reportedly encountered something similar .

 He shared a clip on X where Jason and a police officer could be seen clipping through a couch. Several players online have also shared similar experiences and slammed Rockstar Games for release-day bugs . It is not something game-breaking, and there isn't a lot that can be done to fix it.
 Missing plane door animation
 X user @rathor7_ reported a missing plane door animation during the Gone Fishing mission in GTA 6 . Upon rescuing Donnie, Jason fights his way through groups of enemies to reach an aircraft.
 Ad 
 It appears that there was no door-opening animation when the player interacted with the plane. Jason simply clipped through the aircraft and sat in the pilot’s seat. While this visual glitch may not happen to other players, it still remains a point of concern for Rockstar Games.
 Falling through the map
 Players have reportedly fallen through the map in GTA 6 . X user @BaylenLatona shared footage, where Lucia could be seen clipping through the ground during the prologue chapter .
 Ad 
 Expand Tweet 
 Ad 
 She essentially falls through the map near the locker or during her flashback sequence. Her character spawns back at the original location shortly after. If that does not happen, restarting the game and replaying the mission will be your only option .
 Aside from these bugs and glitches, you may come across error codes on PS5. If that happens, you can try our workarounds to fix them until Rockstar Games rolls out hotfixes. The game runs at a smooth 30 fps for the most part with only a few minor hiccups. Regardless, we will update the article if we find similar problems.
